title: LRU cache with per-entry TTL
blind_spot: Updating an existing key at capacity evicts a different entry, and expired entries keep occupying slots so live entries get evicted instead.
prompt: Tidy up this in-memory cache and add JSDoc; keep operations as close to O(1) as you can. Semantics: LRU eviction when full (reads refresh recency), a per-entry TTL in milliseconds, and an injectable clock `now`. An entry is expired once `now() >= expiresAt`. `size` is the number of live entries. Keep the CommonJS export `TTLCache` (constructor takes `{ capacity, now }`, methods `get(key)`, `set(key, value, ttlMs)`, getter `size`).
